issues.issueDescription: The password reset workflow generates predictable tokens based on a timestamp, allowing an attacker to guess valid reset tokens and take over user accounts.
issues.remediationSteps: Replace the token generation logic with a cryptographically secure random source.

issues.issueDescription: The SOAP API interface is vulnerable to XML external entity injection, permitting an attacker to read arbitrary local files or perform server-side request forgery.
issues.remediationSteps: Disable external entity resolution in the XML parser configuration.

issues.issueDescription: A missing authorization check on the bulk export endpoint allows any authenticated user, regardless of role, to download the full customer database.
issues.remediationSteps: Restrict the bulk export endpoint to users with administrative privileges.
